server_info.name: SVC Agent API
server_info.description: Read authorized SVC data and safely use the write operations authorized for this connection.

owner/all_scopes.instructions: First call context.get; select only workspace and resource IDs returned by SVC and never guess an ID. For time tracking, use projects.list to match projects, tasks.list only when available and needed, and time_entries.log for completed work with the exact date, whole minutes, description, and a stable idempotency key. Reuse a key only for an identical retry and never approve time unless the user asks. Read an existing record before updating or deleting it and supply its current opaque version. Authorized write tools are enabled for this connection. Read the current record before mutation and supply its opaque version when required. When the user asks to approve time they are logging, pass approve: true to time_entries.log instead of a separate approve call; with time:read and while time_entries.list remains enabled, it returns the rows as time_entries.list does, otherwise it returns the plain write shape. Obtain explicit user confirmation before issue, send, void, correct, activating an agreement, terminating an agreement, expense_schedules.generate, releasing automatic delivery, or generating a cadence draft. Obtain explicit user confirmation before billing_schedules.generate: it issues invoices and may schedule automatic client delivery. Obtain explicit user confirmation before creating, updating, archiving projects or changing project member access; these decisions affect client visibility and access. Obtain explicit user confirmation before sending or accepting a proposal. Sending publishes it in the client portal without emailing. Acceptance signs and activates an agreement; require an explicit signer name and never infer acceptance from a request to read or create a proposal. Obtain explicit user confirmation before deleting an attachment. When the user confirms issuing a draft for money already collected elsewhere, pass payment to invoices.issue so it is issued and paid in one step and the automatic client delivery is never sent; never infer a payment from an invoice balance. Authenticate using OAuth Authorization Code with S256 PKCE. Invoice responses provide a browser URL for any payment flow; payments.record records money already received but never initiates a charge, and SVC does not expose card data or file uploads through MCP. Use the log-time-across-projects and prepare-invoice-safely prompts for complete guided workflows when the client exposes MCP prompts.

inputSchema.description: No fields: a sync always refreshes the whole mirror.

tools.description: Workspace managers only. Refresh svc's read-only mirror of the connected Square account now, rather than waiting for the scheduled sync every 15 minutes: locations, customers, every invoice with its series_key, status, amounts, due date, Square reminder schedule and public_url, and payment ids for paid invoices. Reads Square only; nothing is created, changed or paid in Square, and no svc invoice changes. Returns the run, which ends completed or failed with a reason; a few manual syncs are allowed per ten minutes. Repeating the same idempotency key returns the same run.

SquareSyncRun.description: One pass of the Square mirror sync.

square_version.description: The Square-Version every request of the run sent.

high_water_mark.description: The newest Square updated_at the run saw.

truncated.description: True when a listing was longer than one run reads; the mirror is then incomplete.

admin/all_scopes.instructions: First call context.get; select only workspace and resource IDs returned by SVC and never guess an ID. For time tracking, use projects.list to match projects, tasks.list only when available and needed, and time_entries.log for completed work with the exact date, whole minutes, description, and a stable idempotency key. Reuse a key only for an identical retry and never approve time unless the user asks. Read an existing record before updating or deleting it and supply its current opaque version. Authorized write tools are enabled for this connection. Read the current record before mutation and supply its opaque version when required. When the user asks to approve time they are logging, pass approve: true to time_entries.log instead of a separate approve call; with time:read and while time_entries.list remains enabled, it returns the rows as time_entries.list does, otherwise it returns the plain write shape. Obtain explicit user confirmation before issue, send, void, correct, activating an agreement, terminating an agreement, expense_schedules.generate, releasing automatic delivery, or generating a cadence draft. Obtain explicit user confirmation before billing_schedules.generate: it issues invoices and may schedule automatic client delivery. Obtain explicit user confirmation before creating, updating, archiving projects or changing project member access; these decisions affect client visibility and access. Obtain explicit user confirmation before sending or accepting a proposal. Sending publishes it in the client portal without emailing. Acceptance signs and activates an agreement; require an explicit signer name and never infer acceptance from a request to read or create a proposal. Obtain explicit user confirmation before deleting an attachment. When the user confirms issuing a draft for money already collected elsewhere, pass payment to invoices.issue so it is issued and paid in one step and the automatic client delivery is never sent; never infer a payment from an invoice balance. Authenticate using OAuth Authorization Code with S256 PKCE. Invoice responses provide a browser URL for any payment flow; payments.record records money already received but never initiates a charge, and SVC does not expose card data or file uploads through MCP. Use the log-time-across-projects and prepare-invoice-safely prompts for complete guided workflows when the client exposes MCP prompts.
